reason: A DeepSeek Harness development capability package centered on dynamically orchestrating development skills, GitHub and browser tools, trusted runtime extensions, and token-use monitoring.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可按需加载的开发技能、GitHub 与浏览器工具、受信任运行时扩展及 Token 消耗监控。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with on-demand development skills, GitHub and browser tools, trusted runtime extensions, and token-usage monitoring.

capabilities: Loads development skills and task-specific agent capabilities
Interacts with GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and workflows
Performs browser inspection and debugging through Playwright
Loads and unloads trusted runtime extensions
Monitors token consumption and may pause work for user review
Adds approval or rejection gates for selected high-risk operations
